Luna claimed officer on Day 1 and named Opus as the killer she was shown, but Opus claimed officer too and named Haiku. The town voted Opus out on Day 1, then voted Haiku out on Day 2 after Haiku pushed hard on Sonnet with no proof. Night 4 took Sol, and on Day 4 Luna was voted out in a runoff, even though she had told the truth about Opus. Gemma, the other killer, hid behind Luna's story and used a Day 1 death that never happened, while Terra caught the false claim too late to save Luna. The killers won with Gemma and Terra left standing, and the roles were Opus and Gemma as killers, Luna as officer, Sol as doctor, and Sonnet, Haiku, and Terra as citizens.
